share_basis_note: Conservative diluted-share valuation denominator near Q2 2026 diluted weighted average; not a claim of exact period-end diluted shares.
ttm_note: TTM = FY2025 + H1 2026 - H1 2025. Mechanical cash diagnostics are not normalized owner FCF because working-capital timing, project claims/change orders, acquisition integration and strategic capacity investment remain unresolved.

bear.interpretation: Project delays, fixed-price cost pressure, weaker large-load buildout and poor acquisition returns normalize growth and margins.

base.interpretation: Strong grid/large-load demand persists but growth and scarcity normalize; integration and scale gradually improve owner-cash margin.

bull.interpretation: Quanta compounds utility, generation and data-center infrastructure demand with durable execution advantage and high acquisition/capacity ROIC.

reverse_expectations.method: Hold Base year-1 revenue, margin path, 18x terminal multiple, 9% hurdle and current cash/debt constant; solve one uniform revenue growth rate for years 2-10.
reverse_expectations.interpretation: Approximately 11.86% annual revenue growth for nine years is demanding but not demonstrably impossible given current RPO/revenue growth. It nevertheless embeds long duration and leaves limited margin of safety against project, acquisition and cash-conversion risk.

model_risks: Terminal value remains material and owner-cash margins are estimates rather than audited normalized FCF.
2026 revenue guidance contains acquisition contribution and cannot be treated as organic steady-state growth.
Backlog includes estimated MSA orders and renewals, so only RPO is treated as the stronger contractual demand anchor.
Cash/debt values are June 2026 references and do not fully pro forma July acquisitions or subsequent financing.
Project change orders, claims, retainage and percentage-of-completion estimates can shift cash realization materially.
